entities.name: Mezlok
entities.description: Wizard who arrived on Mirrankkar, defeated Jehadt and was named Gordahn's champion.

entities.name: Minoch
entities.description: Mezlok's grandfather, whose name the chief knew.

entities.name: Jehadt
entities.description: Gordahn's warder who claimed the right to represent the village and lost to Mezlok.

events.summary: Mezlok and Taishiar arrive on Mirrankkar and a boy leads them to Gordahn, where the chief welcomes them.
events.quote: He led them back to his village of Gordahn

events.summary: Jehadt claims the right to represent Gordahn and duels Mezlok, who easily wins.
events.quote: Mezlok and Jehadt dueled, with Mezlok easily defeating his challenger.

events.summary: Mezlok is announced as Gordahn's champion in the wizards' duel.
events.quote: Mezlok was then announced to be Gordahn's champion in the wizards' duel.

relations.quote: who knew of Mezlok and even the name of his grandfather, Minoch .
